cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Decide how to check the north line
cards.body:
The check changes how the greenhouse is tested, not how the valves work.

North line

The soak window is the time the bed rests between watering cycles.

PressureReading
North lineStable

Start the north line check now or leave it open for later.

South line

The south reading was stable and needs no follow-up.

Start the north check or leave it waiting?

cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Pressure reading for the west bed
cards.body:
The chart now shows the pressure beside the west bed label.

Public example: PR #1 in Node.js.

BedReading
West bedStable

cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Reservoir level after watering
cards.body: The reservoir returned to its starting level.

cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Heat reading near the vent
cards.body: The vent did not change the heat reading.

cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Watering result for the east bench
cards.body: The east bench received its scheduled amount.

cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Intake pressure needs a second reading
cards.body: The first intake measurement was outside the expected range. A second reading can separate a bad gauge from a change in supply.

cards.author: firstmate
cards.title: Filter pressure dropped after cleaning
cards.body: The filter is back within its normal range. The crew can leave this check closed.
